verdict: key consistent: 87 signs = 87 letters of the cipher's text, 29 groups = 29 words, one letter per shape at skeleton level (S23 = ذ in وذل, د in دا); homophones ب (S5, S8), ن (S9, S11), د (S23, S26). The cipher's mawwal differs from the record in eight words (the cipher writes تنقط where the page has تسقط)
notes: Rows 7r l.12-13 (image 0084_0018) and 7v l.1-6 (image 0084_0019). Signs per row 12,11,11,12,11,11,9,10 = 87 (record 13,12,11,12,12,11,10,12 = 93); dividers 4,4,3,3,4,3,4,5 = 30 (record 29). Cipher's text: يا قلب مو بنقري لي من حروفك خط تقلق ومن قرص بقه في الهوى تنقط / اخضع وذل لمن تهوى ودع يشتط عاش نفس دا شي ما سمع بو قط. Differences from the record, all from the divider groups and shapes that are constant elsewhere: (1) حر وفك is one group of 5 (ح ر و ف ك): حروفك 'your letters'; (2) بقلو is S17 S3 S4 S3 = ت ق ل ق (S17 = ت in تهوى, يشتط; S3 = ق in قلب, بنقري, قرص, بقه; و is always S7): تقلق; (3) يشترط is 4 signs ي ش ت ط, and the page itself reads يشتط; (4) عاشق ولو is 3 signs then a divider: عاش, no ولو in the cipher; a short hooked stroke above S24 on 7v l.5 (next to the margin scribble) is not counted; (5) نقس is ن ف س (S13 = ف as in حروفك, في; the dot-C opening right is ق): نفس; (6) سمح ends with S22 (ع in اخضع, ودع, عاش): سمع; (7) بوفا is two groups S5 S7 | S3 S16 = بو | قط: 'دا شي ما سمع بو قط', 'this is a thing never heard of'. (8) The second sign of تسقط is < (S11), which is ن in من, ومن, لمن, نفس, while س is S25 in نفس, سمع: keyed as written (تنقط), possibly an encipherer's slip. The record's 'answered yes' and the chain's line range are confirmed. Label S20 is not used.
